title: 论文 06：gPINN 与空间残差梯度
titleEn: Paper 06: gPINN and spatial residual gradients
summary: 保留原始一维 Poisson 方程，用硬端点、小型网络和十二次 CPU 运行区分空间残差梯度、参数梯度及点数代价。
summaryEn: Original 1-D Poisson equation, hard endpoints and twelve CPU runs: distinguish spatial residual gradients, parameter gradients and point-count costs.

sources.name: Yu, Lu, Meng & Karniadakis (2022), Gradient-enhanced physics-informed neural networks for forward and inverse PDE problems
sources.text: 2021 preprint, published in CMAME 2022. Sections 2.2 and 3.2.1: coordinate derivatives of the PDE residual and the one-dimensional Poisson example with hard endpoints. Original equation and ansatz retained; network, points and update budget differ.

sources.name: Authors’ gPINN code and examples
sources.text: Original implementation reference. This episode does not implement the paper’s inverse examples or RAR combination.

sources.name: All twelve CPU field, derivative and residual records
sources.text: Three paired seeds; PINN16, PINN32, gPINN16 weight0.01 and weight1. Network1273 parameters, 4000 Adam updates, four CPU threads. All fields, slopes and independent residual checks retained.

slides.title: 论文 06：gPINN 与空间残差梯度
slides.titleEn: Paper 06: gPINN and spatial residual gradients
slides.eyebrow: PINNs 论文 06 / 学习路线
bullets: 保留原始一维 Poisson 方程，用硬端点、小型网络和十二次 CPU 运行区分空间残差梯度、参数梯度及点数代价。
bulletsEn: Original 1-D Poisson equation, hard endpoints and twelve CPU runs: distinguish spatial residual gradients, parameter gradients and point-count costs.

beats.text: 时间加权安排了何时强调残差，现在追问每个空间点约束什么信息。先把受热细杆平衡连接到 Poisson 残差的坐标导数与梯度增强目标。最后用十二次 CPU 运行比较温度、斜率、独立残差，以及更稠密普通 PINN 对照。
beats.textEn: Temporal weighting organised when residuals receive emphasis, so we now ask what information is enforced at each spatial point. We will connect a heated-rod equilibrium to coordinate derivatives of the Poisson residual and a gradient-enhanced objective. Finally, twelve CPU runs will compare temperature, slopes, independent residuals and a denser ordinary-PINN control.

slides.title: 从时间顺序转向样本之间的物理约束
slides.titleEn: From temporal order to physics between samples
bullets: 从时间顺序转向样本之间的物理约束
bulletsEn: From temporal order to physics between samples

nodes.label: 本篇：约束空间残差变化

beats.text: 上一篇改变了训练关注哪些时刻，但残差仍只在有限位置检查。于是还需要追问这些位置之间的空间行为。采样点失配很小，并不一定能控制附近失配变化有多快。
beats.textEn: The previous presentation changed which times receive training emphasis, but every residual was still checked at finitely many locations. That leaves a spatial question about what happens between those locations. A small mismatch at sampled points need not control how rapidly the mismatch varies nearby.

beats.text: 这篇论文加入残差对输入坐标的导数，称为梯度增强 PINN，简称 gPINN。先区分这个空间导数与之前研究的参数梯度，再检验增加的信息及其计算成本。
beats.textEn: This paper adds derivatives of the residual with respect to input coordinates. It is called a gradient-enhanced PINN, or gPINN. We will distinguish that spatial derivative from the parameter gradients studied earlier, then test the added information and its computational cost.

slides.title: 先观察内部加热与冷却的细杆
slides.titleEn: Start with a rod containing heating and cooling
bullets: 先观察内部加热与冷却的细杆
bulletsEn: Start with a rod containing heating and cooling

beats.text: 为了给空间问题一个物理图像，考虑两端温度固定的细杆。内部加热与冷却装置改变平衡温度曲线。动画逐步改变源项，展示一组平衡状态，不是在积分热瞬态。
beats.textEn: To give the spatial problem a physical picture, consider a rod with fixed temperatures at its two ends. Internal heaters and coolers change its equilibrium temperature profile. The animation ramps the source through a family of equilibria, rather than integrating a heat transient.

beats.text: 颜色与金线表示沿位置 x 的温度 u。两端保持固定，内部曲线逐渐形成多个空间尺度。由此可以追问网络是否不仅捕捉温度值，也捕捉空间斜率。
beats.textEn: Colour and the gold curve represent temperature u along position x. The endpoints remain fixed while the interior profile develops several spatial scales. This lets us ask whether a network captures not only temperature values but also their spatial slopes.

slides.title: 稳态热平衡怎样给出 Poisson 方程？
slides.titleEn: How does steady heat balance give a Poisson equation?
bullets: 稳态热平衡怎样给出 Poisson 方程？
bulletsEn: How does steady heat balance give a Poisson equation?

beats.text: 把导热系数归一化为一后，平衡图像变成 Poisson 方程。u 是无量纲温度，x 是位置，s 是给定源项。在这个解释中，正负源项分别表示加热与冷却。
beats.textEn: The equilibrium picture becomes a Poisson equation after conductivity is normalised to one. U is the dimensionless temperature, x is position, and s is the prescribed source. Positive and negative source values represent heating and cooling in this interpretation.

beats.text: 负号使曲率与正的加热源相对。区间从零到 pi，与原论文的一维例子一致。保留这个方程，而不是声称进行了新的大型热模拟。
beats.textEn: The minus sign makes the curvature oppose a positive heating source. The interval runs from zero to pi, matching the original paper’s one-dimensional example. We retain this equation rather than claiming a new large thermal simulation.

slides.title: 固定温度选出具体的平衡状态
slides.titleEn: Fixed temperatures select the equilibrium state
bullets: 固定温度选出具体的平衡状态
bulletsEn: Fixed temperatures select the equilibrium state

beats.text: 曲率方程需要端点值，才能选出具体温度曲线。左端固定为零，右端固定为 pi。这是给定的无量纲值，不是要识别的未知系数。
beats.textEn: The curvature equation needs endpoint values to select a particular temperature profile. The left endpoint is held at zero and the right at pi. These are prescribed dimensionless values, not unknown coefficients to infer.

beats.text: 如果没有两个端点值，附加直线可能不改变源项方程，这在梯度病态论文中已经见过。这里精确满足端点以去掉歧义，使比较聚焦在内部残差信息上。
beats.textEn: Without both values a straight-line offset could leave the source equation unchanged, as we saw in the gradient-pathology paper. Here we remove that ambiguity by enforcing the endpoints exactly. This keeps the comparison focused on interior residual information.

slides.title: 用表达式让端点条件自动成立
slides.titleEn: Make the endpoint conditions hold by construction
bullets: 用表达式让端点条件自动成立
bulletsEn: Make the endpoint conditions hold by construction

nodes.label: 在端点自动消失的因子
nodes.labelEn: A factor vanishing at the endpoints

beats.text: 原论文的替代表达式让边界处理变得明确。N theta 是自由训练的网络，theta 表示其参数。乘子 x 乘以 pi 减 x，在两个端点都为零。
beats.textEn: The original paper’s surrogate makes the boundary treatment explicit. N theta is a freely trained network and theta denotes its parameters. The multiplier x times pi minus x vanishes at both endpoints.

beats.text: 因此，无论参数是什么，输出在左端等于零，右端等于 pi。比较中的 PINN 与 gPINN 使用相同硬约束。它提供边界值，不泄露任何内部参考标签。
beats.textEn: Consequently, the output equals zero on the left and pi on the right for every parameter value. This hard constraint is shared by PINN and gPINN in our comparison. It supplies the boundary values without revealing any interior reference labels.

slides.title: 给定源项包含哪些空间尺度？
slides.titleEn: Which spatial scales appear in the prescribed source?
bullets: 给定源项包含哪些空间尺度？
bulletsEn: Which spatial scales appear in the prescribed source?

beats.text: 端点固定后，给定源项决定内部形状。第一个求和中的索引 j 从一到四。额外的正弦分量具有空间频率八。
beats.textEn: With the endpoints fixed, the prescribed source determines the interior shape. The index j runs from one to four in the first sum. An additional sine component has spatial frequency eight.

beats.text: 这些分量让温度场同时具有宽尺度结构与细节变化。它们是微分方程中已知的源项信息，不是测得的解梯度。解析解保留用于评估训练后的场与斜率。
beats.textEn: These components create a temperature field with broad structure and finer variation. They are known source information in the differential equation, not measured solution gradients. The analytic solution is reserved for evaluating the trained fields and slopes.

slides.title: 先明确普通 PINN 正在压低什么
slides.titleEn: First define what the ordinary PINN minimises
bullets: 先明确普通 PINN 正在压低什么
bulletsEn: First define what the ordinary PINN minimises

beats.text: 现在由物理方程定义网络预测的残差。r theta 是负的网络曲率减去已知源项。普通 PINN 在约束位置最小化它的均方。
beats.textEn: The physical equation now defines a residual for the neural prediction. R theta is negative network curvature minus the known source. An ordinary PINN minimises its mean square at the enforcement locations.

beats.text: 方程应当在整个区间成立，但目标只检查有限点。这种采样区别引出额外的导数信息，不代表标准 PINN 无法产生准确解。
beats.textEn: The equation is supposed to hold throughout the interval, but the objective checks finitely many points. That sampling distinction motivates the added derivative information. It does not mean that a standard PINN cannot produce an accurate solution.

slides.title: 这里的梯度不是参数梯度
slides.titleEn: This gradient is not the parameter gradient
bullets: 这里的梯度不是参数梯度
bulletsEn: This gradient is not the parameter gradient

nodes.label: 对坐标求导：残差怎样变化

beats.text: 现在必须区分梯度这个词的两种含义。之前的平衡论文对可训练参数 theta 求损失导数，告诉优化器怎样移动网络。
beats.textEn: The word gradient now needs careful disambiguation. In the earlier balancing paper we differentiated a loss with respect to trainable parameters theta. That gradient tells the optimiser how to move the network.

beats.text: 这里对空间位置 x 求残差导数，测量物理失配从一个位置到另一个位置怎样变化。之后优化器仍需要参数梯度，但新增损失使用的是这个坐标导数。
beats.textEn: Here we differentiate the residual with respect to spatial position x. This measures how the physics mismatch changes from one location to another. The optimiser still needs parameter gradients afterwards, but the added loss is defined using this coordinate derivative.

slides.title: 用局部切线理解新增信息
slides.titleEn: Use a local tangent to explain the added information
bullets: 用局部切线理解新增信息
bulletsEn: Use a local tangent to explain the added information

beats.text: 坐标导数有简单的局部几何含义。h 表示从约束点出发的小空间偏移。虚线是示意残差曲线的切线，不是保存的网络预测。
beats.textEn: The coordinate derivative has a simple local geometric meaning. Here h is a small spatial offset from an enforcement point. The dashed line is a tangent to an illustrative residual curve, not a saved network prediction.

beats.text: 对于较小偏移，残差值与残差斜率共同描述附近失配的一阶变化。因此同时降低两者，比只降低样本值提供更多局部约束。但近似仍有余项，不能保证处处残差为零。
beats.textEn: For a small offset, residual value and residual slope together describe the nearby mismatch to first order. Reducing both can therefore constrain local behaviour more than reducing only the sampled value. The approximation still has a remainder, so it is not a guarantee of zero residual everywhere.

slides.title: 把残差导数加入训练目标
slides.titleEn: Add the residual derivative to the objective
bullets: 把残差导数加入训练目标
bulletsEn: Add the residual derivative to the objective

beats.text: 局部解释引出 gPINN 目标。L r 是残差均方，L g 是空间残差导数均方。gamma 是所选损失权重，控制额外导数项。
beats.textEn: The local argument leads to the gPINN objective. L r is the mean squared residual, and L g is the mean squared spatial residual derivative. Gamma is a chosen loss weight controlling the extra derivative term.

beats.text: 稀疏比较中，两项使用相同的十六个约束点。不增加任何解值或解斜率观测。每次运行保持权重固定，而不是使用之前梯度论文的自适应规则。
beats.textEn: Both terms use the same sixteen enforcement points in the sparse comparison. No new solution or solution-slope observations are added. The weight is fixed during each run rather than controlled by the adaptive rule from the earlier gradient paper.

slides.title: 为什么会出现温度的三阶导数？
slides.titleEn: Why does a third temperature derivative appear?
bullets: 为什么会出现温度的三阶导数？
bulletsEn: Why does a third temperature derivative appear?

beats.text: 对已定义残差求导，就能解释实现中的高阶导数。温度二阶导数变为三阶导数。已知源项也必须求导，而且保持相同负号。
beats.textEn: Differentiating the defined residual explains the higher derivative in the implementation. A second derivative of temperature becomes a third derivative. The known source must also be differentiated, with the same minus sign.

beats.text: 源项以解析形式给定，因此它的导数可计算。这不是把隐藏参考解的导数当成标签提供。判断增强方法实际获得了什么信息时，这一区别尤其重要。
beats.textEn: The source derivative is available because the forcing function is prescribed analytically. It is not the derivative of a hidden reference solution supplied as a label. This distinction is essential when judging what information the enhanced method actually receives.

slides.title: 高阶导数对网络有什么要求？
slides.titleEn: What do higher derivatives require from the network?
bullets: 高阶导数对网络有什么要求？
bulletsEn: What do higher derivatives require from the network?

beats.text: 三阶导数不仅改变使用的信息，也改变计算要求。由于残差需要重复对输入求导，选择平滑双曲正切激活。分段线性激活不能提供相同的普通高阶导数。
beats.textEn: The third derivative changes the computational requirements as well as the information used. We choose smooth hyperbolic-tangent activations because the residual needs repeated input differentiation. A piecewise-linear activation would not provide the same ordinary higher derivatives.

beats.text: 创建导数计算图也增加每步优化成本。因此约束点较少，并不自动代表 CPU 运行更快。除了比较点数，还加入更稠密的普通 PINN 对照。
beats.textEn: Creating those derivative graphs also adds cost to each optimiser step. Fewer enforcement points therefore do not automatically mean a faster CPU run. We include a denser ordinary-PINN control rather than comparing point counts alone.

slides.title: 代码保留源项导数与参数梯度
slides.titleEn: The code preserves source derivatives and parameter gradients
bullets: 代码保留源项导数与参数梯度
bulletsEn: The code preserves source derivatives and parameter gradients

beats.text: 现在把方程连接到实际求导辅助函数。它先由网络曲率和给定源项构造残差，再对残差求 x 导数。所得导数仍保留训练所需计算图。
beats.textEn: The equations can now be connected to the executed derivative helper. It constructs the residual from network curvature and the prescribed source before differentiating that residual in x. The resulting derivative still retains the graph needed for training.

beats.text: 最终反向传播对网络参数求合成目标导数。四行代码概括这个计算，完整 Python 下载中含真实 autograd 调用。拟合目标中没有参考斜率标签。
beats.textEn: The final backward pass differentiates the combined objective with respect to network parameters. The displayed four lines summarise that calculation, while the full Python download contains the actual autograd calls. No reference-slope labels appear in the fitting objective.

demoCode: u, ux, r, rx = derivatives(model, x, True)

slides.title: 怎样同时比较点数、权重与代价？
slides.titleEn: How do we compare points, weights and cost?
bullets: 怎样同时比较点数、权重与代价？
bulletsEn: How do we compare points, weights and cost?

beats.text: 对照把增加约束位置与导数增强区分开。比较十六点普通 PINN、三十二点普通 PINN，以及权重为零点零一和一的十六点 gPINN。相同种子使用配对初始网络。
beats.textEn: The controls separate more enforcement locations from derivative enhancement. We compare ordinary PINN with sixteen points, ordinary PINN with thirty-two points, and sixteen-point gPINN with weights zero point zero one and one. Initial networks are paired by seed.

beats.text: 每次运行包含一千二百七十三个参数、四千步 Adam、双精度和四个 CPU 线程。保留九十秒训练上限，但这十二次都完成了更新预算。原论文使用不同网络和长得多的训练日程。
beats.textEn: Every run uses one thousand two hundred and seventy-three parameters, four thousand Adam updates, double precision and four CPU threads. A ninety-second training cap is retained, although these twelve runs all completed their update budget. The original paper uses a different network and a much longer training schedule.

slides.title: 先回放实际温度曲线
slides.titleEn: First replay the measured temperature profiles
bullets: 先回放实际温度曲线
bulletsEn: First replay the measured temperature profiles

beats.text: 保存的训练曲线显示不同目标在种子十一上实际产生了什么。蓝色是稀疏普通 PINN，金色是增强权重零点零一，粉色是增强权重一。虚线是独立解析温度参考。
beats.textEn: The saved training curves show what the different objectives actually produced for seed eleven. Cyan is the sparse ordinary PINN, gold is enhancement weight zero point zero one, and pink is enhancement weight one. The dashed curve is the independent analytic temperature reference.

beats.text: 最终检查点中，小权重增强在这个种子上明显降低了稀疏基线的场误差。这是本地实测结果，不是论文报告的精度。判断取舍前，还需要检查斜率、其他种子以及更稠密对照。
beats.textEn: At the final checkpoint the small-weight enhanced run reduces the sparse baseline’s field error substantially in this seed. That is a local measured outcome rather than the paper’s reported accuracy. We still need to inspect slopes, other seeds and the denser control before judging the trade-off.

slides.title: 温度看起来准确，斜率也准确吗？
slides.titleEn: If temperature looks accurate, are its slopes accurate?
bullets: 温度看起来准确，斜率也准确吗？
bulletsEn: If temperature looks accurate, are its slopes accurate?

beats.text: 物理解释说明导数值得单独检查。u x 是温度斜率，在导热系数归一化后，除符号外决定热通量。较小相对场误差可能掩盖这个更敏感量的较大误差。
beats.textEn: The physical interpretation makes the derivative worth checking separately. U x is the temperature slope and determines heat flux up to the normalised conductivity and sign. A small relative field error can hide a larger error in this more sensitive quantity.

beats.text: 在种子十一中，稀疏基线斜率误差约百分之九点六，小权重增强约百分之零点一七。这些数值来自保存的导数场，不是对绘图线做数值差分。后面的比较也会保留更稠密基线。
beats.textEn: For seed eleven, the sparse baseline’s slope error is about nine point six percent, while the small-weight enhanced run is about zero point one seven percent. These values come from the saved derivative fields, not numerical differences of the plotted line. The next comparison keeps the denser baseline visible as well.

slides.title: 查看约束点之间的真实残差
slides.titleEn: Inspect the real residual between enforcement points
bullets: 查看约束点之间的真实残差
bulletsEn: Inspect the real residual between enforcement points

beats.text: 斜率比较提示我们检查约束位置之外的物理失配。这里是在独立网格上计算的最终网络残差。下轴标记显示十六个约束点位置，不是额外观测解值。
beats.textEn: The slope comparison motivates checking the physical mismatch away from the enforced locations. These are final network residual profiles on the independent grid. The marks on the lower axis show where the sixteen enforcement points lie, not extra observed solution values.

beats.text: 另外在二百五十七个偏移点上评估残差与残差导数误差，用于检验训练位置之间的行为。这仍是有限的独立检查，不是整个区间一致正确的证明。
beats.textEn: We separately evaluate residual and residual-gradient errors at two hundred and fifty-seven shifted points. This tests behaviour between the training locations. It remains a finite independent check rather than a proof of uniform correctness throughout the interval.

slides.title: 值与斜率都为零，仍不是全局证明
slides.titleEn: Zero sampled values and slopes are not a global proof
bullets: 值与斜率都为零，仍不是全局证明
bulletsEn: Zero sampled values and slopes are not a global proof

nodes.label: 中点处残差与导数为零
nodes.labelEn: Residual and slope vanish at midpoints

nodes.label: 中点之间仍有非零残差

beats.text: 一个简单残差示意说明，导数增强为何不能取消验证需求。在本实验的十六个中点位置，十六 x 的余弦为零。因此余弦平方残差在每个位置的值和一阶导数都为零。
beats.textEn: A simple residual illustration explains why derivative enhancement does not remove the need for validation. At our sixteen midpoint locations, cosine of sixteen x is zero. The squared cosine residual therefore has both zero value and zero first derivative at every one of those locations.

beats.text: 但在这些位置之间，同一残差会达到非零值。这是关于有限约束的逻辑反例，不是在声称它就是训练网络的残差。更多导数条件提供信息，却不能替代采样与独立检查。
beats.textEn: Between the locations, the same residual reaches nonzero values. This is a logical counterexample about finite constraints, not a claim that it is the trained network’s residual. More derivative conditions provide information, but they are not a substitute for sampling and independent checks.

slides.title: 把权重敏感性和稠密对照放在一起
slides.titleEn: Compare weight sensitivity with the denser control
bullets: 把权重敏感性和稠密对照放在一起
bulletsEn: Compare weight sensitivity with the denser control

beats.text: 现在的完整比较包含全部种子与两种点数。每个点表示相对空间斜率误差，共四组策略。三十二点普通 PINN 使用的位置，是十六点增强运行的两倍。
beats.textEn: The full comparison now includes every seed and both point counts. Each dot is relative spatial-slope error, with four policy groups. The thirty-two-point ordinary PINN uses twice as many locations as the enhanced sixteen-point runs.

beats.text: 这些种子中最优增强权重会变化，更稠密普通基线在当前预算下也非常准确。额外导数可以帮助稀疏基线，但不一定成为整体成本与精度的最优选择。这些对照避免把点数效率混同为普适 CPU 效率。
beats.textEn: The best enhancement weight changes across these seeds, and the denser ordinary baseline is very accurate under this training budget. Extra derivatives can help a sparse baseline without becoming the best overall cost-accuracy choice. These controls prevent point efficiency from being confused with universal CPU efficiency.

slides.title: 同时检验温度、斜率和独立残差
slides.titleEn: Validate temperature, slopes and held-out residuals
bullets: 同时检验温度、斜率和独立残差
bulletsEn: Validate temperature, slopes and held-out residuals

beats.text: 导数误差图使用明确的验证量。u 星表示解析参考，下标 x 表示空间求导。E 下标 u x，是独立网格上的斜率相对欧几里得误差。
beats.textEn: The derivative-error plot uses an explicitly defined validation quantity. U star denotes the analytic reference, and the subscript x denotes spatial differentiation. E subscript u x is relative Euclidean error in the slope over the independent grid.

beats.text: 同时保存相对温度误差、精确端点值、独立残差误差与残差导数误差。参考斜率不进入训练，也不使用验证值选择检查点。所有最终结果和配对种子都保留。
beats.textEn: We also save relative temperature error, exact endpoint values, held-out residual error and held-out residual-gradient error. None of the reference slopes enter training, and no validation value selects a checkpoint. Every final result and every paired seed is retained.

slides.title: 本篇实现了论文的哪一部分？
slides.titleEn: Which part of the paper is implemented here?
bullets: 本篇实现了论文的哪一部分？
bulletsEn: Which part of the paper is implemented here?

nodes.label: 原始一维方程与硬边界

beats.text: 本篇实现了论文原始一维 Poisson 方程及其硬端点替代表达式。为保持本机可运行，修改网络宽深、约束点集与优化更新预算。报告的是自己实际运行的误差。
beats.textEn: This episode implements the paper’s original one-dimensional Poisson equation and its hard-endpoint surrogate. We change the network width and depth, enforcement sets and optimiser update budget to keep the experiment local. The reported errors are our own executed outcomes.

beats.text: 本篇没有实现反问题、多维问题或残差自适应加点。高阶导数计算图每步也更昂贵，因此点少不能单独证明训练更快。三个种子展示局部取舍，而不是普适最优。
beats.textEn: We do not implement the inverse examples, multidimensional problems or residual-adaptive refinement in this presentation. Higher derivative graphs also cost more per step, so fewer points alone do not prove faster training. Three seeds demonstrate a local trade-off rather than a universal optimum.

slides.title: 先预测改变点数与权重的影响
slides.titleEn: Predict before changing the points or weight
bullets: 先预测改变点数与权重的影响
bulletsEn: Predict before changing the points or weight

nodes.label: 一次只改变一个因素
nodes.labelEn: Change one factor at a time

nodes.label: 比较场与导数两种误差

beats.text: 稀疏与稠密对照带来一个无需新模拟的小练习。先固定网络与种子，预测更多约束位置或更强导数惩罚，哪个更可能帮助这个源项。说明预计温度或斜率中的哪种误差变化更大。
beats.textEn: The sparse and dense controls give a small follow-up exercise without a new simulation. First keep the network and seed fixed and predict whether more enforcement locations or a stronger derivative penalty should help this source. State which error, temperature or slope, you expect to change more.

beats.text: 下载脚本在 run 函数附近明确列出四种策略。在副本中一次修改一个因素，并使用新输出文件。比较实际训练时间、两种验证误差和独立残差，再判断修改是否有益。
beats.textEn: The downloadable script exposes all four policy definitions near the run function. Make one controlled modification in a copy and use a new output filename. Compare actual training time, both validation errors and the held-out residuals before deciding that the change helped.

slides.title: 为什么下一篇要研究把点放在哪里？
slides.titleEn: Why study where enforcement points are placed next?
bullets: 为什么下一篇要研究把点放在哪里？
bulletsEn: Why study where enforcement points are placed next?

nodes.label: 本篇增加每个点的信息
nodes.labelEn: This paper adds information at each point

beats.text: 梯度增强改变每个位置受到什么信息约束，但本篇仍使用固定均匀点。独立残差曲线提示了另一个选择：有限点应该放在哪里？因此需要用单独论文研究基于残差的自适应采样。
beats.textEn: Gradient enhancement changes what information is enforced at each location, but we still used fixed evenly spaced points. The independent residual profiles suggest another choice about where the limited points should go. That motivates a separate paper on residual-based adaptive sampling.

beats.text: 下一篇在一个可解析检验的 CPU 边界层小问题上比较采样策略。候选搜索成本与总点数预算都会保持可见。由此区分增加导数信息与选择更有信息量的约束位置。
beats.textEn: The next presentation compares sampling policies on a small analytically checkable boundary-layer problem. It keeps the candidate-search cost and total point budget visible. This separates adding derivative information from choosing more informative enforcement locations.
